task.description:
Step 2b (Design Gate) for WF03-ISS0774-20260924. HARD GATE.
Read lib/letflow/design/iss-0774-select-live-row-determinism.md independently.
Check: root cause stated precisely with evidence, fix specified as exact one-line code change, regression test design specified (fail-first proof), AC traceability complete, no implementation code.
Complete handoff (step-02b-design-gate.json): status COMPLETED, result.status PASS or FAIL.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause analytically justified (not just asserted)
Regression test design: fail-first proof described

root_cause_justified.notes: Erlang sorted atom key order proven: ':microsecond' < ':minute' < ':second' < ':year'. First differing key for second-boundary timestamps is ':microsecond', so tuple {999000,6} > {1,6} despite representing an earlier wall-clock instant. Concrete table with example pair provided. Analytically sound.

fix_specified.notes: Exact one-line change: Enum.max_by(many, &{DateTime.to_unix(&1.updated_at, :microsecond), &1.id}). File and location specified. DateTime.to_unix/2 with :microsecond is a valid stdlib call returning a plain integer. Secondary id key handles true-tie case. No ambiguity.

fail_first_proof.notes: Boundary pair explicit: stale ~U[2024-01-01 00:00:05.999000Z] (µs=999000) vs fresh ~U[2024-01-01 00:00:06.000001Z] (µs=1). Old code: Erlang struct comparison picks stale (bug demonstrated). New code: integer comparison picks fresh. Assertion json_response(conn, 200)["id"] == fresh.id fails with old code, passes with new.

ac_traceability.notes: AC1 (flake fix), AC2 (no_defect for SandboxPoolTest), AC3 (root cause), AC4 (rationale) — all mapped in §4 with clear reasoning.

no_implementation_code.notes: §2 shows a one-line old/new diff as specification. §3 shows a test skeleton as test design. No module body or full function implementation present.

result.summary: All five checks PASS. Design is analytically complete and unambiguous. Safe to route to ELIXIR-DEV.
